construct: Pendrin, encoded by SLC26A4, is expressed at the apical membrane of thyroid follicular cells and participates in iodide transport into the follicular lumen. Biallelic SLC26A4 variants cause Pendred syndrome, characterized by sensorineural hearing loss with goiter and variable thyroid dysfunction/iodide organification defects.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Congenital sensorineural hearing loss plus goiter with preserved basolateral iodide uptake localizes the thyroid defect to SLC26A4/pendrin-mediated apical iodide movement.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Basolateral sodium-iodide symporter dysfunction is the strongest alternative thyroid-transport answer, but the stem explicitly states iodide uptake from blood into thyrocytes is preserved.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: Only apical pendrin dysfunction fits both the Pendred phenotype and the membrane-transport localization encoded by the stem.
